laura.name: {{copilot}}

account_file.name: Account file

contacts.name: Contacts
contacts.why: The list is re-read every time it is opened, with no frozen copy.

influence_map.name: Influence map
influence_map.why: It is built from the stored graph alone: a corrected name or title stays invisible there until the next analysis.

score.name: Account score
score.why: The score has no human author: no correction recomputes it. It stays the one from the last analysis.

plan.name: Action plan
plan.why: The plan is written once by the analysis: a correction does not rewrite text already drafted.

meetings.name: Meetings
meetings.why: The brief re-reads contacts every time it is opened.

future_research.name: Future research
future_research.why: The company name and registration number go out corrected, but the context steering the next search is still the one from the last analysis.

writeRequests.title: Writes to approve

empty.title: Nothing is waiting for you
empty.body: No automatic write is pending. Your own actions go out without passing through here: the click is the decision.

notConnected.title: No CRM connected
notConnected.body: With no CRM connected nothing can be written — this queue will stay empty, and that is not the same as “everything is approved”.

autoWrites.title: What goes out without a click
autoWrites.body: Sync fills in empty fields on its own — email and phone — on a contact in your CRM, without a click from you; it never overwrites a value already entered. Any other write (replacing a value, creating a record, a note, a task…) waits for a preview and your approval.

notConfigured.title: CRM writing unavailable
notConfigured.body: This capability is not open on this environment. Nothing is pending, and nothing can be.

failed.title: The read failed
failed.body: This is not “nothing is waiting”: the queue could not be read. Reload the screen in a moment.

confrontation.title: Confront with the CRM
confrontation.description: What your CRM already knows, compared with what {{brand}} found — on the last snapshot already in the database, no call to the CRM.
confrontation.importedSource: No CRM is connected: the comparison covers the contacts imported from your CRM that are already in this account.

notConnected.title: No CRM connected
notConnected.body: With no CRM connected nothing can be confronted — this comparison stays empty until a CRM is connected to this workspace.

confrontation.empty: No duplicate detected against the CRM on this snapshot.
confrontation.hint: A proposal, never an automatic merge — you choose which record to keep. No field is ever overwritten: a hand-made correction is never replaced.
